system.description:
Choose from your inventory one [Throwing] weapon you can equip with IR [CR-5 (at least 1)] or more. During this main process, you can use the range of the selected [Throwing] weapon to do a Ranged Attack as if you had a [Throwing] tag.

A special skill that allows him to pull out a thrown weapon at speeds that are unnoticeable. You can skillfully use hitting and throwing.
